title: Unit Event — Light Up the Fire — Episode2 The Truth Behind That Night

meta.Episode: Episode2 — The Truth Behind That Night
meta.Event Outline: Vivid BAD SQUAD's explosive third event has roused expectations that the team might actually surpass RAD WEEKEND. That's when Taiga summons them for "an important conversation"...

rows.Line: Vivid Street

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Even if we spend our whole lives trying...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Wait, what do you mean by that...?

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Just that.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: None of you understand exactly what it is that you're trying to surpass.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: I mean, how can you clear a hurdle if you don't know how high it is?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Wh-What do you mean I don't understand? I saw it for myself...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'm sorry, but I'm having trouble grasping what exactly it is that you're trying to say, Taiga... Would you mind elaborating a bit more?

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line:
Yeah, sure.
That's why I gathered you all here today.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: I'm sure you all felt this for yourself during your third event...

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: A good event isn't just about each person's performance. It's also vital to work as a unit and become one with the crowd.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: I mean, no one wants to see some self-absorbed jerk hog the stage.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Based on what I saw, you've established some strong bonds.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Because you can't put on a good show if you're not all motivated and working towards the same goal.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Yes, we understand that...
We have to be on the same page if we really want to put on a great event.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line:
And RAD WEEKEND is no exception.
It was a big event for a reason.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: All the best singers were there, and we became one with the crowd. That was our goal from the start.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Yes, that we understand...

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: So, doesn't that mean we have a chance to achieve our goal...?

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: Y-Yeah, I mean...

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: Azusawa helped us get a better idea of what it means to become one with the crowd.

rows.Speaker: Tatsuya
rows.Line:
She did.
It also solidified our collective goal of wanting to surpass RAD WEEKEND.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line:
Yeah, I know.
You've made it this far, so it's clear that you all have potential.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: But... You're not gonna surpass it for one simple reason.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: You aren't enough. Not by a long shot.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Wait...! Okay, yeah. Compared to you guys, we still have a lot of work to do. But if we keep improving like this, I'm sure someday—

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: You're missing the point.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: I don't doubt that you'll keep getting better. Even if there's a massive skill gap between me and the rest of you, your chances of reaching my level won't be zero.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: But I'm talking about what's in here. Your heart.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: What do you mean...?

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: That night became what it was because of one thought, one idea...

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Without that, there was no way RAD WEEKEND would've become the event it did.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: One thought...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I still don't understand...

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Our goal was to put on one final event worthy of the end of her life.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: The end of her life...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Her...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line:
An, what's wrong?
Don't tell me you're still sulking...

rows.Speaker: Junior High School An
rows.Line:
B-But...!
Aunt Nagi just left without saying anything...!

rows.Speaker: Junior High School An
rows.Line: If I knew that she was leaving for the US, I would've at least gone and told her goodbye...

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Well, this is her we're talking about...

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Seeing you might've made having to go just that much harder.

rows.Speaker: Junior High School An
rows.Line: But...!

rows.Speaker: Junior High School An
rows.Line: No, I'll just make her beg me for my forgiveness when she gets back!

rows.Speaker: Junior High School An
rows.Line:
Hm...?
What's wrong?

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line:
Oh, um...
Nothing.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: No...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But... W-Wait, that's... Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: It was the last event for a certain musician.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: We gave absolutely everything we had and sang ourselves hoarse for her. And the crowd made sure they would never forget one second.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: And this musician's name was...?

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Nagi.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: *Gasp*

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: RAD WEEKEND was Nagi Kotaki's final event. It was meant to be my little sister's swan song.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: She found out she was sick and had just months to live, and she decided to use what little time she had left to put on one last event in this neighborhood.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: That was RAD WEEKEND.

rows.Speaker: Tatsuya
rows.Line: So, Nagi... She passed away...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: No...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
What are you saying, Uncle Taiga...?
You're just joking, right...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
But, she went over to the US...
I mean, everyone around town said so...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: No one told me she'd—

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: You of all people should know, An...

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: In the eyes of the neighborhood, you and Nagi were like family...

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: They'd do anything for you, including shielding you from the truth.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Shielding her...?

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line:
From the truth...?
Does that mean they all worked together to lie to her...?

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: N-No, that can't be possible...!

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: That would mean everyone from Vivid Street...! They seriously all kept the fact that Nagi was dead quiet?

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: How could a whole neighborhood hide the fact that someone had died?!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Why would they do that?

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: For one reason and one only. Because Nagi wanted it that way.

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: Please...

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: Can you do this? For me?

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line:
Nagi's gone...
And everyone around here knows that already.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: The only people who don't know are those who started hanging out here recently...

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: And you, An.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: No... It's not possible...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: How do you expect me to believe a story like...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line:
Everyone here's known Nagi forever.
A lot of them since she was born.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Which is why...

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: They probably felt obligated to respect her final wishes.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (He isn't kidding...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (It's all...true.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (I've never seen this look on Uncle Taiga's face before...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (So that means, Aunt Nagi, she...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (She's really...?)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
...
Why?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Why did you keep this from me?!

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Like I said, this is what Nagi wanted.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line:
You'll have to ask Ken about the rest.
For now, there's something else that I need to tell all of you.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Something else...?

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Remember what I said just now? You'll probably keep getting better, and your chances of reaching my level won't be zero, even if there's a huge skill gap between us.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: The kids who saw RAD WEEKEND are all grown up now. And so, you all have a better idea of that skill gap. Am I right?

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: I borrowed some mics and speakers from that live house over there. You guys decide how you wanna use them.

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: Use these...? W-Wait, you don't mean...?!

rows.Speaker: Tatsuya
rows.Line: What?! Against Taiga...?!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Wh-What are you doing...?!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: You... You have to explain everything to me first! Tell me what happened to Aunt Nagi...! Tell me everything! Now!!!

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Geez, you really are a handful. Alright, fine...

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line:
How do you feel now, An?
Ready to dance?

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line:
You're gonna surpass that night, right?
Nagi's last hurrah. When everyone in this town came together for her...

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: RAD WEEKEND.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Wh-What do I do...?!>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <I-I've gotta go tell the others...!>
